content: Some of the prior studies have also taken into account the sentimental characteristics of a word when creating word vectors BIBREF5, BIBREF6, BIBREF7. A model with semantic and sentiment components is built in BIBREF8, making use of star-ratings of reviews. In BIBREF9, a sentiment lexicon is induced preferring the use of domain-specific co-occurrence statistics over the word2vec method and they outperform the latter.
